elaine: Quick ping 1: onboarding run for cerberus-30k-q3 produced a reproducible KV-stitch checksum flip only after a long prefill + resumed streaming. Minimal repro and logs below.

bob: Can you paste the tiny failing tail?

elaine: Minimal tail (prefill=17600 seed=202):
```
[2026-04-12T08:40:00Z] PREFILL: wrote 17600 tokens to kv(shard0)
[2026-04-12T08:40:03Z] KV_STITCH_CHECK: window[17536..17600] expected=0x4b2f got=0x4a2f
[2026-04-12T08:40:03Z] GENERATE: first mismatch token_idx=17687
[2026-04-12T08:40:03Z] MODEL_CTX: max_pos=30720 prefill=17600 inflight=287 pos_encoder=auto
```
Fails 4/4. With prefill <= 15000 it's clean.

tom: Hmm. That difference (0x4b2f -> 0x4a2f) looks like a single-bit change in a rolling hash. Any phase dumps?

elaine: I ran per-pos sin/cos dumps fp16 vs q3 and spot-diffed. Observed a repeating sawtooth micro-step every ~256 positions starting around pos 16k that toggles a low bit in the 64-token rolling hash. Script used: `tools/phase_sweep.py --model cerberus-30k-fp16 --out=fp16.npy` and same for q3 then `scripts/phase_saw.py fp16.npy q3.npy`

kernel-bot: quick-check (run id g1p9): model=cerberus-30k-q3 prefill=17600 throughput=12.1 toks/s kv_flip_rate=1.8% reproducible=4/4 link: https://ci/rep/g1p9

bob: Did you try forcing `--pos-mode=clamp` or `--force-angle=f16`? Also try `--kv-flush-after-prefill=true` to rule out stale-page writes.

elaine: Try matrix: forced f16 angle fixes 3/3, clamp reduces to 1/3, kv-flush alone no effect. So forcing fp16 angle seems to mitigate.

tom: That pattern (period 256) suggests the quant encoder LUT stride is 256 entries or the kernel packs trig entries in 256-block blocks. Q3 encoding might be aliasing due to coarse LUT with no smoothing.

kernel-bot: Suggested short-term gate: onboarding harness set `force-angle=f16` for q3 when prefill > 15000 for models with max_pos >= 30000.

bob: For triage: collect hex-dump of kv bytes around the mismatch (addr-128..addr+128), per-token 32-bit hash for positions (pos-512..pos+512) for both fp16 and q3, and the scripts producing the sawtooth plot. Attach to a kernel issue.

elaine: Uploaded artifacts to ticket draft: "q3-lut-saw: periodic phase micro-step -> KV rolling-hash flip (cerberus-30k-q3)". Included sawtooth PNG, npy dumps, and the exact prompt+seed.

tom: Long-term fix idea: either increase LUT resolution above pos_threshold or apply a tiny linear-correction filter to quantized angles to preserve monotonicity and bound per-pos delta. Also add a numeric regression to runtime-tests: scan positions 0..max_pos, compute rolling-hash delta between fp16 and quant encoder, assert no single-step flips that exceed threshold.

ci-bot: follow-ups created: (1) gating in onboarding harness (force-angle=f16 for q3 prefills > 15k), (2) kernel issue created with artifacts #KB-4521, (3) runtime unit test task assigned to @tom. CI link: https://ci/issues/KB-4521

elaine: I'll run a small param sweep (prefill 12k..18k step 1k) to find hysteresis boundary and attach CSV to the ticket. Thanks all. :rocket:
